description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform' that manages attribute transformations in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for transforming attributes, prepending CSS, and confiscating attributes, which are used during HTML sanitization to modify and manage element attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform
classes.description: Abstract class for processing attribute arrays for HTML sanitization, allowing modifications based on multiple attribute values, prepending CSS, and removing attributes.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to modify attributes based on multiple values, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: prependCSS
methods.description: Prepends CSS to the 'style' attribute, creating the attribute if it does not exist.

methods.name: confiscateAttr
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a specified attribute from the attribute array.
